name: Momofuku
dsc: Momofuku's legendary Bo Ssäm dinner is a Korean-American feast featuring a slow-roasted pork shoulder that is caramelized on the outside and incredibly tender on the inside. Served with a variety of traditional accompaniments including oysters, kimchi, and lettuce wraps, this meal is perfect for sharing. The pork is seasoned with a sweet and savory glaze that creates a crispy crust while locking in juices. This dinner kit includes all the components needed to recreate the iconic Momofuku experience at home. Ideal for special occasions or weekend gatherings with family and friends, the Bo Ssäm offers a unique blend of flavors and textures that will impress any guest.

name: Commander's Palace
dsc: Commander's Palace Seafood Gumbo is a New Orleans classic that has been perfected over generations. This rich, dark roux-based gumbo is loaded with fresh shrimp, crab meat, and oysters, all simmered slowly with the holy trinity of onion, celery, and bell pepper. The deep, smoky flavor comes from a carefully crafted blend of spices that have made this dish a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Perfect for any occasion, this gumbo is a taste of Louisiana's culinary heritage.

name: Gramercy Tavern
dsc: The Gramercy Tavern Burger is a masterpiece of simplicity and quality. Made from a custom blend of dry-aged beef, this burger is juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Served with caramelized onions, melted cheese, and a signature sauce on a toasted bun, it's a true New York classic. This 4-pack includes everything needed to recreate this award-winning burger at home. Perfect for burger lovers who appreciate the finest ingredients and classic techniques.

name: Blue Ribbon
dsc: Blue Ribbon's 'The Coop' is a complete fried chicken dinner that delivers crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned fried chicken. The chicken is brined in a secret blend of spices, then double-fried to achieve a golden, crunchy exterior while keeping the meat moist and tender. Served with classic sides like mashed potatoes and coleslaw, this dinner is perfect for family gatherings or casual meals.

name: Chef Francis Mallmann
dsc: Chef Francis Mallmann's Traditional Beef Empanadas are a taste of Patagonian soul food. These hand-crafted empanadas are filled with seasoned ground beef, onions, olives, and hard-boiled eggs, then baked to golden perfection. The accompanying Llajua sauce, made with fresh tomatoes and chilies, adds a spicy kick that complements the savory filling. Perfect as an appetizer or a main meal, these empanadas are a true culinary journey.

name: Momofuku
dsc: Momofuku's Pork Buns are a cult favorite, featuring tender, slow-braised pork belly tucked inside a fluffy steamed bun. Topped with hoisin sauce, sliced cucumbers, and scallions, these buns offer a perfect balance of sweet, savory, and fresh flavors. This 12-pack is ideal for parties, gatherings, or a delicious snack at home. Each bun is handcrafted to ensure the highest quality and authentic taste.

name: Marcus Samuelsson's Streetbird
dsc: Marcus Samuelsson's Hot Honey Chicken & Cornbread Waffles kit brings the flavors of Harlem to your kitchen. Crispy fried chicken is drizzled with a spicy hot honey glaze, then served atop fluffy cornbread waffles. This sweet and spicy combination is a modern classic. The kit includes everything needed to prepare this delicious meal for 4, complete with chef-inspired instructions.

name: Zahav
dsc: Zahav's Hummus & Salatim Spread is a celebration of Israeli flavors. The hummus is creamy and smooth, made from high-quality chickpeas and tahini. The salatim includes a selection of fresh salads like Israeli salad, pickled vegetables, and roasted eggplant. This spread is perfect for sharing with friends and family.

name: Pizzeria Bianco
dsc: Pizzeria Bianco's wood-fired pizzas are widely regarded as some of the best in the country. This best-seller 4-pack includes a selection of their most popular pizzas, each with a perfectly charred crust, fresh ingredients, and simple yet flavorful toppings. Baked in a wood-fired oven, these pizzas offer an authentic taste of Naples right in your home.

name: Gramercy Tavern
dsc: Gramercy Tavern's Mushroom Lasagna is a vegetarian delight packed with layers of fresh pasta, creamy béchamel, and a rich mushroom ragù. The earthy flavors of wild mushrooms are complemented by hints of thyme and Parmesan cheese. This lasagna is a comforting and elegant dish that is perfect for a special dinner.

name: Eventide Oyster Co.
dsc: Eventide Oyster Co.'s Brown Butter Lobster Roll is a Maine classic with a twist. The lobster meat is tossed in warm brown butter, giving it a rich, nutty flavor. Served on a toasted split-top bun with a sprinkle of chives, this lobster roll is a must-try for seafood lovers. This 4-pack kit includes everything needed to create these iconic rolls at home.

name: Commander's Palace
dsc: Commander's Palace Shrimp & Grits dinner is a celebration of Southern cuisine. Jumbo shrimp are sautéed with Andouille sausage and served over creamy stone-ground grits, all finished with a rich, buttery sauce. This three-course meal also includes a starter salad and a decadent dessert, making it a complete dining experience.

name: Cote Korean Steakhouse
dsc: Cote Korean Steakhouse's Butcher's Feast is an extraordinary dining experience featuring a selection of premium dry-aged steaks, including ribeye, strip, and tenderloin. These steaks are served with traditional Korean banchan and a variety of dipping sauces. This feast is perfect for those who appreciate the finest cuts of meat in a Korean BBQ style.

name: RedFarm
dsc: RedFarm's Whole Peking Duck Kit is a culinary showstopper. The duck is roasted to perfection with a crispy skin and succulent meat, served with traditional accompaniments like scallions, cucumbers, and hoisin sauce. This kit includes everything needed to make your own Peking duck pancakes at home.

name: Underbelly by Chris Shepherd
dsc: Underbelly's Unconventional Texas BBQ Sampler offers a unique take on traditional barbecue. Featuring brisket, pulled pork, and smoked sausage, each meat is prepared with a modern twist that reflects Houston's diverse culinary scene. Perfect for those looking to explore new flavors.

name: Blue Ribbon Sushi
dsc: Blue Ribbon Sushi's DIY Kit for 2 is perfect for sushi lovers who want to try their hand at making authentic sushi at home. This kit includes premium sushi-grade fish, seasoned rice, nori, and all the necessary accompaniments. It's a fun and interactive dining experience.

name: Zahav
dsc: Zahav's Lamb Shoulder Meal Kit is a feast of Israeli flavors. The lamb is slow-cooked until tender and served with a variety of traditional sides including rice, pickled vegetables, and fresh salads. This meal is perfect for sharing and celebrating special occasions with loved ones.

name: Blue Ribbon
dsc: Blue Ribbon's Classic Plateau Seafood Dinner is an opulent feast featuring a selection of the finest shellfish, including lobster, crab, shrimp, and oysters. Served with a variety of sauces and accompaniments, this dinner is perfect for a romantic evening or a special celebration.

name: Wolfgang Puck Catering
dsc: Wolfgang Puck's Mac and Cheese & Chicken Pot Pie combo offers two comfort food classics. The mac and cheese is creamy and cheesy, while the pot pie is filled with tender chicken and vegetables in a savory sauce. This combo is perfect for a cozy night in.

name: Cote Korean Steakhouse
dsc: Cote's Prime Galbi Steak Feast is a Korean BBQ lover's dream. This feast includes premium bone-in short ribs marinated in a sweet and savory sauce, grilled to perfection at your table. Served with a variety of banchan, this meal is a complete experience.

name: Chef Francis Mallmann
dsc: Chef Francis Mallmann's Dry-Aged Ribeye Steak Dinner Kit brings the flavors of Patagonia to your table. The ribeye is dry-aged for maximum flavor, then grilled to perfection over an open flame. Served with chimichurri sauce and roasted vegetables, this is a meal for steak lovers.

name: Pizzeria Bianco
dsc: Pizzeria Bianco's Choose Your Own 4-Pack allows you to customize your pizza selection. Each pizza is crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients and baked in a wood-fired oven. Choose from a variety of classic and innovative toppings.

name: Fox & the Knife
dsc: Fox & the Knife's Pasta Dinner Gift Basket is a curated selection of artisanal pastas and sauces. Featuring a variety of shapes and flavors, this basket is perfect for pasta lovers. Each ingredient is carefully selected to ensure a delicious and authentic Italian meal.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Chinese Tea Smoked Whole Duck is a flavor-packed dish that combines traditional smoking techniques with aromatic tea leaves. The duck is smoked to perfection, resulting in a crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat. This is a true culinary adventure.

name: Chef Francis Mallmann
dsc: Chef Francis Mallmann's Traditional Beef Empanadas 24-Pack is perfect for large gatherings. These savory pastries are filled with a flavorful mixture of beef, onions, olives, and eggs. The accompanying Llajua sauce adds a spicy, fresh finish.

name: Fox & the Knife
dsc: Fox & the Knife's Pasta Dinner for 4 allows you to choose your favorite pasta shapes and sauces. Each dish is made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and is designed to delight. Customize your meal to suit your taste preferences.

name: Marcus Samuelsson's Streetbird
dsc: Marcus Samuelsson's Fried Chicken Wings are a flavor explosion. These wings are brined, double-fried, and tossed in a spicy hot honey glaze. Served with a cooling buttermilk ranch dip, they are perfect for sharing as an appetizer or a main course.

name: Johnny Sanchez
dsc: Johnny Sanchez's Taco Combo Kit for 4-6 lets you customize your taco experience. Choose from a variety of protein options and fresh toppings, all accompanied by house-made salsas. Perfect for a fun and interactive meal at home.

name: Momofuku
dsc: Momofuku's Shiitake Mushroom Buns are a vegetarian twist on their famous pork buns. These buns are filled with savory, marinated shiitake mushrooms, hoisin sauce, and fresh scallions. They are a delicious and satisfying alternative for plant-based eaters.

name: Commander's Palace
dsc: Commander's Palace's Legendary Turtle Soup is a New Orleans institution. This rich, dark soup is made with tender turtle meat, a flavorful roux, and a blend of spices that create a deeply savory and satisfying dish. It's a must-try for anyone visiting the city.

name: Blue Ribbon Sushi
dsc: Blue Ribbon Special Sushi DIY Kit for 2-3 offers a premium sushi-making experience. This kit includes high-quality sushi-grade fish, seasoned rice, and all the necessary accompaniments. It's a fun and educational activity for sushi enthusiasts.

name: Raoul's
dsc: Raoul's Burger Au Poivre is a French-inspired burger that is elevated by a rich peppercorn sauce and melted cheese. This 4-pack kit includes everything needed to recreate this iconic dish at home. Perfect for a gourmet burger night.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Pork and Shrimp Wontons are a classic Chinese favorite. Each wonton is hand-folded and filled with a flavorful mixture of pork and shrimp, then boiled to perfection. Served with a dipping sauce, these wontons are perfect as an appetizer or a snack.

name: Fox & the Knife
dsc: Fox & the Knife's Pasta Dinner for 2 is a romantic meal that can be customized to your taste. Choose from a selection of fresh pastas and sauces, all made with premium ingredients. Perfect for a date night at home.

name: Chef Francis Mallmann
dsc: Chef Francis Mallmann's Traditional Argentinian Asado Feast is a massive spread for 10-12 people. Featuring a variety of meats including beef, sausages, and chorizo, all grilled over an open fire. This feast is a celebration of Argentine culinary traditions.

name: Pizzeria Delfina
dsc: Pizzeria Delfina's Neapolitan Pizza 4-Pack allows you to choose your favorite combinations. Each pizza is made with a perfectly charred crust, San Marzano tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella. A taste of San Francisco's famous pizza scene.

name: Holeman & Finch
dsc: Holeman & Finch's Double Stack Burger Kit is a Southern classic. This kit includes premium beef patties, soft buns, and all the fixings needed to create a delicious double-stack burger at home. Perfect for a casual get-together.

name: Momofuku
dsc: Momofuku's Whole Bo Ssäm Dinner for 8-10 is a show-stopping feast. Featuring a whole roasted pork shoulder, oysters, kimchi, and all the traditional accompaniments, this meal is perfect for large gatherings and celebrations.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Potstickers and Dumplings Combo Pack is a best-seller. This pack includes both chicken jiaozi dumplings and giant cheese burger potstickers, offering a delicious variety of flavors. Perfect for sharing or as a satisfying snack.

name: The Slanted Door
dsc: The Slanted Door's Vietnamese Dinner Kit for 4 offers a customizable dining experience. Choose from a variety of Vietnamese classics like pho, spring rolls, and caramelized fish. This kit is a culinary journey through the flavors of Vietnam.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Chicken Jiaozi Dumplings are a classic Chinese appetizer. Each dumpling is filled with a savory mixture of chicken and vegetables, then boiled to perfection. Served with a soy-based dipping sauce, these are perfect for any occasion.

name: Momofuku
dsc: Momofuku's Whole Plate Short Rib Dinner is a decadent and flavorful meal. The short ribs are braised until incredibly tender and served with a rich, savory sauce and your choice of sides. Perfect for a special dinner at home.

name: Fox & the Knife
dsc: Fox & the Knife's Best Sellers Pasta Dinner for 4 features a selection of their most popular pasta dishes. Each dish is made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and is sure to impress. A taste of Boston's vibrant culinary scene.

name: Ivan Ramen
dsc: Ivan Ramen's Best Seller Ramen Kits bring the authentic flavors of Tokyo to your kitchen. Each kit includes rich, flavorful broth, fresh noodles, and a variety of toppings. This 4-pack is perfect for ramen lovers and offers a complete meal experience.

name: Frontera Grill
dsc: Frontera Grill's Carnitas Taco Kit is a taste of authentic Mexican cuisine. The carnitas are slow-cooked until tender and served with fresh tortillas, salsa, and all the classic toppings. Perfect for a taco night at home.

name: Pizzeria Delfina
dsc: Pizzeria Delfina's Neapolitan Pizza 3-Pack is a smaller version of their popular 4-pack. Choose your favorite toppings and enjoy the perfectly charred crust and fresh ingredients. Perfect for a cozy pizza night.

name: Eventide Oyster Co.
dsc: Eventide Oyster Co.'s Brown Butter Lobster Roll 6-Pack is perfect for entertaining. Each roll is filled with tender lobster meat tossed in warm brown butter and served on a toasted bun. A taste of Maine's best seafood.

name: Johnny Sanchez
dsc: Johnny Sanchez's Taco Fiesta Pack is a party in a box. This kit includes everything needed for a taco feast, including queso, margarita mix, and all the fresh ingredients. Perfect for fiestas and celebrations.

name: Blue Ribbon
dsc: Blue Ribbon's Crustacean Plateau Seafood Dinner is an extravagant feast featuring lobster, crab, shrimp, and oysters. Served with a selection of sauces and fresh garnishes, this dinner is perfect for special celebrations.

name: Blue Ribbon
dsc: Blue Ribbon's Family Coop is a complete fried chicken dinner for 8-10. Featuring a generous portion of crispy, juicy fried chicken, this meal is perfect for large family gatherings and celebrations.

name: Gramercy Tavern
dsc: Gramercy Tavern's Burger + Kielbasa Combo offers a delicious combination of their famous burger and a savory kielbasa sausage. This meal is perfect for those who want to enjoy the best of both worlds.

name: Summer Shack
dsc: Summer Shack's Lobster Pot Pie and Crab Cake Combo is a seafood lover's delight. The pot pie is filled with tender lobster in a creamy sauce, while the crab cakes are crispy and full of flavor. Perfect for a special dinner.

name: Wolfgang Puck Catering
dsc: Wolfgang Puck's Truffle Chicken Pot Pie Kit for 4 is a luxurious take on a comfort food classic. The pot pie is filled with tender chicken and truffle-infused mushrooms in a creamy sauce, topped with a flaky crust.

name: Frontera Grill
dsc: Frontera Grill's Carnitas Taco Kit for 4-6 is a larger version of their popular kit. This kit includes more carnitas, tortillas, and toppings, making it perfect for family dinners and gatherings.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Gluten-Free Orange Chicken Kit is a healthier take on a Chinese favorite. The chicken is crispy and coated in a sweet and tangy orange sauce, all made without gluten. Perfect for those with dietary restrictions.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Taiwanese Style Pork Chop Dinner Kit is a flavorful and satisfying meal. The pork chops are marinated in a savory sauce and pan-fried until crispy. Served with rice and pickled vegetables, this is a taste of Taiwanese home cooking.

name: Taïm
dsc: Taïm's Best Seller Falafel Kit is a vegan delight. The falafel is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, made from a blend of chickpeas and fresh herbs. Served with pita, hummus, and fresh vegetables, this kit is perfect for a healthy and delicious meal.

name: Blue Ribbon Sushi
dsc: Blue Ribbon Sushi's Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice DIY Kit is a fun and interactive dining experience. This kit includes crispy rice cakes, spicy tuna, and all the necessary toppings. Perfect for sushi lovers who enjoy a hands-on meal.

name: RedFarm
dsc: RedFarm's Signature Sampler offers a taste of their most popular dishes. Featuring a variety of dumplings, buns, and other Chinese specialties, this sampler is perfect for sharing and discovering new favorites.

name: AFURI
dsc: AFURI's Yuzu Shio Ramen Kit brings the taste of Japan's famous ramen to your home. The broth is light and citrusy, made with yuzu and salt, and the noodles are perfectly chewy. A refreshing and delicious ramen experience.
